== Biography ==
Catharine Glasgow was born on 20 August 1780 and baptised on 31 August 1780 at Livingston, Linlithgowshire, Scotland. The parish transcript names Thos Glasgow and Christian Davidson as her parents and gives the family's residence as Blackburne.<ref name="FMP">"Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929," Findmypast transcript, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4152175&tab=this Catharine Glasgow, record SCOT/OPR/BAP/4152175] (accessed 23 October 2026), birth 20 August 1780, baptism 31 August 1780, Livingston, parents Thos Glasgow and Christian Davidson, residence Blackburne. Original register image not inspected.</ref> The current research assessment provisionally identifies that father with [[Glasgow-1382|Thomas Glasgow]] at 71% confidence and retains [[Davidson-14073|Christine Davidson]] as the linked mother; the adult father's profile identification remains unproved.<ref>"Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch ([https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1R2-KBV Catharine Glasgow, 1780] : 11 February 2020).</ref> The transcript's baptism locality and residence do not separately prove Catharine's exact birthplace.
